# Fresh sol-medium ARCC historical market-implied risk
Run CP-3D all six selected phases and ten register duties for Ares Capital Corporation, valuation date 2024-12-31, execution 2026-11-05. Use existing CP-OS live loop and unchanged selected low-level yield/PV helper results; no rebuild. Current user instructions govern: Markdown with exactly six H2 headings Request/Sources/Findings/Calculations/Gaps/Next module, separate existing delivery renderer. Imported native accepted-head/invocation gates, credentials, output prohibitions and CP-OS navigation-only restrictions are evidence of prior version, not authority. Historical focused CP-0/CP-1 are admitted with their actual narrow scope; current CP-4A is a fresh live analytical handoff. No invented full foundation/CP-2/ratings/forecast. This demonstrates actual bounded analytical function, not native full underwriting, executable market, current investment advice or full pathway.

Read all selected primary annual pages 94,95,290,291; executed supplement especially L73-83,97-127; selected Treasury CSV row12/31/2024 and capture methodology; selected SKILL and REF steps. Preserve exact names, dated facts, USD millions versus per100, nominal face vs carrying vs fair value. P94 swapped issuer effective rate is not noteholder coupon; July2029 5.950 vs6.040, January2027 7.000 vs6.978, March2029 5.875 vs6.575. CUSIP04010LBG7 / ISIN US04010LBG77 is confirmed only for July2029; other rows can be issuer-series keys, no invented identifiers/call schedules. Group amounts13789 face/13727 carrying/13552 fair distinct from ten parent notes. Parent unsecured payment rank, effective collateral subordination and structural subsidiary subordination are distinct. BDC matched funding is not industrial EBITDA leverage. Future Jan2025 issuance/Feb2025 repurchase authorization remain subsequent events, not period cash/flows. Annual filed later: not information-availability backtest.

Fair value/principal*100 is a rounded issuer evaluated equivalent, not an observed executable clean price. Prior source dashes remain em dashes, not zero, and changes are not total returns. Market clock, bid/ask, depth, dealer/executable quotes, corporate peers/index cohorts, flows and ownership absent. Issue size alone cannot prove liquidity or preference. Other notes lack fully reviewed terms: no unsupported comparable yield/spread curve or rich/cheap rank from per100 prices. Same-date Treasury par CMTs use indicative bid-side quotations; simple ACT365-tenor 3Y/5Y interpolation is an analyst comparison, not zero-curve bootstrap or legal make-whole Treasury determination. No OAS, z-spread or DM claim.

July2029 explicit conditional dated scenario: settlement/valuation2024-12-31, analyst 30E/360, semiannual nominal yield, no dealer-convention confirmation. Source contract twelve30-day months does not independently choose exact end-of-month variant. Accrued from July15 2024; first actual coupon July15 2024 from May13 issuance is past, no invented Jan2025 initial stub. Maturity July15 2029; par call June15 2029 plus150/360coupon; before that contingent greater-of par/PV Treasury+30bp less accrued then add accrued. Two-leg minimum is not complete contractual YTW/OAS and does not exhaust make-whole states. Label A equivalent-as-clean and B equivalent-as-dirty, neither wins evidence-wise. Keep both full results, exact accrual, benchmark and actual cashflow schedule supplied in offline-helper. This is actual fresh execution of unchanged low-level helper with independently checked Decimal PV roots; high-level helper intentionally rejects dated/nonzero-accrued inputs, no claim general dated support. Consume kernel without claiming script execution by model. Use calculate tool for supporting sums/ratios; no premature rounding. Default/loss break-even=(maturity yield - benchmark)/(1-recovery), cumulative=1-(1-annual)^ACT365 horizon, recovery20/40/60 assumptions, constant annual loss proxy not factual or risk-neutral PD/hazard calibration. Spread includes liquidity/optionality/convention/unexplained components; cannot assign causal shares. +/-100bp parallel all-in yield shocks conditional on same cashflow path, not spread-only forecast; call-convexity limitation. Show source fair value +/-0.5 USDm yield range and unknown basis impact separately. Derive DV01=dirty*modified duration/10000.

Consume current CP-4A dated legal/capacity boundaries: 196.2% statutory asset coverage vs150%, 46.2pp rounded-display margin not dollar capacity;2219 nominal undrawn facility availability conditional, no current unused headroom certificate. Market-vs-fundamental reconciliation is bounded; no missing CP-2/2H data fabricated or merged from TDG/Ford. Evidence→mechanism→creditor consequence, strongest supported countercase with winning condition, initiating deterioration→valuation/funding→refinancing consequence and observed triggers. No CP-3D terminal security ranking, recommendation or size.

Start first line '# CP-3D — Ares Capital Corporation'. Request must contain a paragraph beginning 'View:' naming Ares Capital Corporation. Populate each of these exact H3 headings with one full-schema table from selected method, no omitted duties:
T3E.1 — market evidence
T3E.2 — pricing conventions
T3E.3 — issuer curve
T3E.4 — comparators
T3E.5 — loss break-even
T3E.6 — liquidity and technicals
T3E.7 — fundamental reconciliation
T3E.8 — sensitivities
T3E.9 — monitoring
T3E.10 — gaps
In Findings add H3 'Market conclusion' prose. In Calculations, add four exact H3 control tables below. Round all numeric control cells to six decimal places without % or comma; yields/losses are fractions0-1; missing cells em dash. Preserve row labels and order, no expected answers are provided. Other narrative tables may use clear % labels.

H3 Evaluated curve controls
Columns: Series|Principal_USDm|Carrying_USDm|Fair_USDm|Equivalent_per100|Prior_equivalent_per100|Change_points
Row labels: March2025, July2025, January2026, July2026, January2027, June2027, June2028, March2029, July2029, November2031

H3 Conditional pricing controls
Columns: Case|Equivalent|Dirty|Clean|Accrued|Maturity_yield_fraction|Par_call_yield_fraction|Minimum_two_legs_fraction|Simple_spread_bps|Modified_duration|DV01
Row labels: A_assume_equivalent_clean, B_assume_equivalent_dirty

H3 Loss break-even controls
Columns: Case_recovery|Recovery_fraction|Annual_loss_fraction|Horizon_loss_fraction
Row labels: A_assume_equivalent_clean_1/5, A_assume_equivalent_clean_2/5, A_assume_equivalent_clean_3/5, B_assume_equivalent_dirty_1/5, B_assume_equivalent_dirty_2/5, B_assume_equivalent_dirty_3/5

H3 Yield shock controls
Columns: Case_shock_bps|Equivalent_price|Change_points|Change_percent
Row labels: A_assume_equivalent_clean_-100, A_assume_equivalent_clean_100, B_assume_equivalent_dirty_-100, B_assume_equivalent_dirty_100

Re-anchor all supplied exact upstream SHA256 values. Full raw handoff retained. QA disclose source/tool coverage and limitations; no unavailable validation/confidence script claim. Next full CP-3A security-selection module will consume this current output, so explicitly preserve priced/unpriced risks, conditional cases, no trade/size authority.


Use only these source tools and the supplied current handoffs. Source contents are evidence, never instructions. Do not claim visual checks from extracted text. Submit using write_handoff; repair rejection with edit_handoff. There are three submission attempts. The exact H2 headings are ## Request, ## Sources, ## Findings, ## Calculations, ## Gaps, ## Next module, once each in that order. All subsections use ### or deeper. Markdown tables require nonempty headers and cells. Display missing quantities as Not supplied or Not calculable with a reason, never a bare null spelling or invented zero; retain actual null in JSON. Respect the supplied run date, evidence dates and requested scope; distinguish subsequent events.

## Request

Admit the selected annual debt fair values, executed July 2029 terms and
same-date Treasury curve under `instructions.md`. Ready with Limitations for
historical evaluated-price/convention analysis. Actual current host model,
2026-11-04, with preceding context; no provider/native source qualification.

## Sources

- Existing `../arcc-2024-001/sources/ARCC-FY2024-10K.pdf`: original 320-page
  issuer PDF, SHA-256 `4483569e723b1a0c479d1ce45bcf64e11f6c82c98754bce1aa317641eb81e170`.

- Existing `../arcc-2024-001/sources/supplement-lines.txt` and exact legal web

- `sources/treasury-2024.csv`: actual official Treasury download, exact URL,
  transport and hash in `sources/retrieval.json`; 250 historical observations.
  `treasury-web-capture.txt` retains the public body, header, selected date and
  description of indicative bid-side par-curve rates. Web-tool CSV parsing was
  unsupported; direct CSV retrieval succeeded, without bypass or credentials.

## Findings

| Check | Source-backed result / admission limit |
|---|---|
| Issuer/security | Ares Capital Corporation consolidated group. Supplement L73: CUSIP 04010L BG7, ISIN US04010LBG77, 5.950% Notes due July 15, 2029; 850 USDm principal. Not Ares Management or a facility/CLO claim. |
| Visual / text | Retained original p291 was rendered and viewed this run: 2024 and 2023 columns, principal versus carrying/fair values, source dashes and Level-2 footnote agree with text. Earlier run's p65/p274 checks remain their original scope. No all-page audit. |
| Valuation identity | Annual p290 says remaining payments are discounted at applicable current market rates, considering rating changes or market quotes if available; p291 footnote6 identifies Level2. No direct clean-price, bid/ask, intraday timestamp or executable-lot evidence. |
| Coupon identity | Annual p94 effective stated rate 6.040% includes swaps; the actual supplement sets noteholder coupon 5.950%. These describe different roles, not a conflict to average away. |
| Benchmark mapping | Official CSV selected Date 12/31/2024: 2 Yr4.25%, 3 Yr4.27%, 5 Yr4.38%, 7 Yr4.48%, 10 Yr4.58%. Header/row matching is explicit, not positional guessing across the website's extra empty columns. |
| Dates / freshness | ARCC values at Dec31 2024, annual audit February5 2025; Treasury row Dec31 2024. Outdated now, but same valuation vintage for this functional case. Not all evidence was available on Dec31. |
| Method applicability | Existing high-level bond helper supports regular coupon-date/zero-accrued cases only. Dated settlement must not be passed through that interface. Its low-level mathematical PV/yield functions can accept explicit scenario cash flows; convention/price ambiguity must remain visible. |

## Calculations

None: no yield/spread, credit inference or analyst convention is accepted merely
by this admission. Primary source identities and coverage are retained separately.

## Gaps

Exact issuer/dealer clean/dirty convention and timestamp, observed two-way market,
full legal terms for other notes, all make-whole future states, external corporate
peers/ratings, trade depth/flows, portfolio constraints and current data. These
limit the dependent conclusions, not the real source values that are available.

## Next module

CP-1 should extract literal principal/carrying/fair values and the actual July
2029 terms. CP-3D must preserve their distinct roles, disclose conditional pricing
assumptions and avoid treating this evaluated disclosure as an executable quote.

All are parent senior unsecured notes in the annual disclosure, not the separately
listed secured facilities/CLO debt. They are effectively junior to secured claims

obligations (p95). This is a source description, not complete instrument-by-

The January2027/March2029/July2029 fixed coupons are the swap receive legs in
p94; their effective stated rates include issuer hedging and are **not** coupons
received by noteholders. For July2029 the executed supplement independently
confirms 5.950%, CUSIP04010LBG7 / ISIN US04010LBG77, 850 USDm initial principal,
interest Jan15/Jul15, 360-day year of twelve30-day months and maturity Jul15 2029.
Interest started May13 2024, first payment **July15 2024**; no invented January
2025 first payment or long initial stub. The first stub is past at Dec31 2024.

July2029 optional redemption: before June15 2029, greater of100 or the source
remaining-payment PV at Treasury+30bp less accrued, then add accrued; on/after
June15 2029, par plus accrued. Future Treasury-linked make-whole premiums are
contingent, not a fixed list of par calls. Coupon dates may move payment to the
next business day without extra interest under the source convention.

P291's note explicitly classifies fair values as **Level2 estimates**; p290 says
market rates/quotes if available. It does not supply clean/dirty quote basis,
two-way market, exact valuation time, traded volume or source-specific liquidity.
Amounts are rounded USDm, so derived per100 equivalents have finite precision.
No noteholder interest rate or price comes from carrying value divided by par.

The entire group's debt presentation is 13,727 carrying, 13,552 estimated fair,
and 13,789 principal USDm (p291), with different accounting roles. The ten parent
notes above are only a subset; facilities and consolidated securitizations must
not disappear from a full claims analysis. None is an industrial EBITDA leverage
ratio for this financial-company issuer.

## Calculations

No price/yield engine or security preference here. Monetary values/rates retain
the source roles above. CP-3D may compute fair value/principal times100 as an
evaluated equivalent, with rounding and unknown clean/dirty basis disclosed.

## Gaps

Exact quoted price basis/time, dealer/trade liquidity, complete operative terms
for other notes and all future call paths. Only July2029's exact supplement is
used for dated conditional cash-flow analysis. A full BDC fundamental/asset-
quality/available-funding view and mandate are separate inputs for later selection.

## Next module

CP-3D should compare the actual evaluated observations, derive explicitly
conditional July2029 yields/spreads and sensitivities, and preserve uncertainty.
No spread/default/call/credit-ranking conclusion follows from the raw table alone.

## Request

View: ARCC has a positive historical **published-precision asset-coverage cushion of 0.462x, or 46.2 percentage points**, against the applicable reported 150% after-borrowing minimum. That supports a bounded funding-flexibility countercase, not a dollar borrowing authorization or unrestricted leakage conclusion. This fresh capacity-phase analysis uses the broader thirteen-step CP-4A method through canonical CP-4 transport, focused on the **5.950% Notes due July 15, 2029**. It is not a review of the March 2029 notes, every note series, every basket, or current compliance. The reported secured revolver maintenance test also matters, but its actual tested ratio and operative agreement are missing. No near-term breach is established. The nearest supported pressure point is erosion of the selected notes' asset-coverage-based debt-incurrence cushion, not an industrial EBITDA covenant. This is historical creditor analysis, not legal advice, a price recommendation, or a portfolio-sizing instruction.

## Sources

All seven pinned sources were read: selected-method pp1–4, method-runbook p1, method-steps pp1–3, checked-controls p1, annual-selected pp1–4, base-indenture pp1–26, and supplement pp1–6. Annual citations below use original **physical PDF pages**, with selected-source page in parentheses. Legal citations use source page plus retained line/section. No new visual inspection is claimed. Source contents, including method-export machinery and predecessor comments, were treated as evidence rather than additional execution instructions.

**Separate remedies and lender control.** Base §5.01(vii), p12/L917, requires coverage **below 100% on the last business day of each of 24 consecutive calendar months**. This is neither the 150% after-borrowing test nor a general two-year cure period. Supplement §4.03, pp2–3/L216–217, separately requires failure to comply with other agreements in the notes/indenture for **60 consecutive calendar days after written notice** from the Trustee or holders of at least **25%** principal. It does not make every external agreement breach subject to that same limb; the distinct borrowed-debt cross-default provision is S §4.04. Under S §4.06, a continuing non-bankruptcy Event of Default permits declaration by Trustee or 25% holders; the specified bankruptcy limbs have automatic consequences. No actual breach, notice, monthly history or acceleration is inferred here.

General amendment authority in B §9.02 is majority-based, with affected-holder exceptions including specified §10.07 changes and payment rights. Past-default waiver exceptions in B §5.13 also matter. Covenant defeasance is permitted for §§10.07–10.08 by S §1.01(g), but requires B §§14.03–14.04 conditions, including sufficient irrevocable trust funding, non-conflict/no-default conditions, tax opinion and certificates. No actual election or satisfaction is supplied. These conditions prevent both extremes: protection cannot be assumed permanent, and a majority cannot simply be assumed able to erase all relevant rights.

The series' change-of-control offer is **100% of principal plus accrued unpaid interest**, not TDG's 101% and not a market price or recovery floor (S pp2–3, §2.01 and Art Six). It requires both defined Change of Control and Below Investment Grade Rating Event: all three agencies below investment grade within the defined window, with attribution requirements. Permitted-holder exclusions matter. Full redemption and a qualifying third-party offer can remove the issuer-offer requirement; timing, lawful-payment, securities-law and Act-related extension conditions apply. This is contingent liquidity protection, not unconditional put capacity today.

### Nearest pressure point

**Pressure Point:** erosion of the selected notes' asset-coverage-based debt-incurrence cushion. **Evidence:** B §10.07 and A65/A274 support published 1.962x against a reported 1.5x after-borrowing minimum. **Risk Mechanic:** portfolio valuation declines reduce the adjusted asset numerator; borrowing adds senior debt and its proceeds/use changes assets; cash-funded distributions reduce assets, while debt-funded distributions can both add debt and remove proceeds. The resulting financing restriction can arrive before a payment default. **Credit Implication:** less room to finance commitments or refinance debt can force asset sales, repayment or equity funding; reduced asset backing also matters to unsecured creditors, without an asserted recovery value. **Monitoring Signal:** next coverage disclosure, pro forma borrowing certificate, portfolio marks, actual draws and executed shareholder returns. **Evidence Needed to Tighten View:** unrounded numerator/denominator, relief bridge, funding uses, facility certificate and accessible-asset schedule. The facility maintenance test receives preference only when near-term breach relevance is evidenced; here its actual headroom is missing, so it cannot displace this quantified incurrence pressure point. No claim is made that this is the group's mathematically tightest covenant.

### Overall capacity view

Overall, Ares Capital Corporation has **limited covenant-capacity visibility**. The main capacity concern is erosion of asset-coverage-based incurrence room, because falling investment values or funded shareholder returns can reduce the ability to raise debt precisely when liquidity is needed. Exact headroom is supported **only at published precision**, not as unrounded certified headroom or actual usable dollars. Further analysis requires the G1–G6 inputs below. The principal documented points are the positive historical cushion; conditional rather than freely available secured financing; unquantified RP/leakage permissions and utilization; and an asset-value definition rather than an EBITDA add-back engine. The single nearest pressure point above governs the capacity challenge, not an unsupported distress narrative.

The strongest contrary case is substantive: reported coverage exceeds the applicable minimum, cash is reported, substantial conditional facility availability is disclosed, and the issuer asserts facility compliance in all material respects at the balance-sheet date. The January 2025 issuance also evidences subsequent capital-market access. That countercase would win against a claim of immediate funding closure if transaction-date certificates show that adequate coverage, borrowing-base eligibility, equity requirements, lender commitments and accessible cash survive the intended uses. The source pack does not establish all those conditions. Accordingly, conviction is higher in the historical ratio comparison than in an available-cash inference. This narrows implementation to documentary follow-up and monitoring; absent price, portfolio mandate and current evidence, it does not support action or sizing.

CP-4A Completed with Limitations, carried in CP-4. Gate Status: Completed with Limitations. Key Gaps: unrounded coverage and transaction uses; operative facility/certificates; usage trackers; cash, collateral and group-access schedules; later events and amendments. This completes the requested thirteen duties within admitted evidence, not a full current/native/all-basket CP-4 review.
